title: Create issue #8981: Craftings from stock keeper do not seem to work with craftings & crafters that are bigger than 3x3
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (NOASSERTION) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by Stef-DP] ### Description if you have a **crafting** bigger than `3x3` (such as crushing wheels) the stock keeper says "Not enough ingredients to craft" or the "+" button doesn't appear at all even if you have all the ingredients required
Images at the time of this picture, the vault connected to the stock link had enough items to craft it
Also if you have a **crafter** bigger than `3x3` (such as `4x4` ot `5x5`) the packages by the stock keeper do not seem to store the shape of the crafting but instead it follows the horizontal left to right, top to bottom order causing the item to fail to craft
Image For this image, the crafter is `4x3` and it was requested to craft a block of diamond, it placed the diamonds as `4 - 4 - 1` instead of `3 - 3 - 3` causing them to just drop instead of creating the block
